what_it_does: This paper presents infrastructure connecting the Advanced Light Source (a synchrotron radiation facility that produces intense X-rays for materials research) to large supercomputers at national laboratories. Synchrotrons generate enormous volumes of complex data that require sophisticated reconstruction algorithms. The system enables two key workflows: real-time streaming of data to supercomputers while experiments are running (for immediate feedback to scientists) and automated batch processing of datasets for intensive 3D reconstructions using both conventional processors and graphics processing units.
